Kalyk...lis Kolinienko nd subsequently became her p r mour.
At th t time Miss K lyk ...s a member of the Seattle branch of
the "Komsomol" (Communist Youth League), an organization
which was responsible for the holding of meetings of members of the
Communist Party in Seattle together with the crews of Soviet
ships. Platoff corresponded with Miss Kalyk for some
considerable time and upon his invitation she came to Shanghai
about one year ago, since which time she has cohabited with
him. Following her arrival here certain local Russian
communists objected to Platoff's conduct on the ground that
Miss Kalyk was not to be trusted as she conveyed the impression
that she did not entertain proletarian leanings and that she
would "corrupt" Platoff. Platoff then pointed out that she
was an idealist worker and had participated in Soviet activities
in the U.S.A. Although Miss O.A.Kalyk has not come to our
notice as having taken any active part in local communist
work, it is known that she has on several occasions typed
certain secret documents in English at the request of local
Soviet agents.
On May 26, 1933, V.G.Platoff and Miss O. Kalyk were
married at the local American Consulate-General. At present
they occupy Flat 204, Dubail Apartments, 181 Avenue Dubail,
telephone No.80731.
Recently Mrs. Platoff left Shanghai for Tsingtao
on holiday.

D. B.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

卡雷克……利斯·科利年科（Kalyk...lis Kolinienko），随后成为她的保护人。
当时，卡雷克小姐是西雅图“共青团”（共产主义青年团）分支的成员，该组织负责在西雅图与苏联船只船员一起举行共产党成员会议。普拉托夫（Platoff）与卡雷克小姐通信了相当长一段时间，并在他的邀请下，她于大约一年前来到上海，自那时起便与他同居。在她抵达此地后，某些当地俄国共产党人反对普拉托夫的行为，理由是卡雷克小姐不可信任，因为她给人的印象是她并不持有无产阶级倾向，并且会“腐蚀”普拉托夫。普拉托夫随后指出，她是一位理想主义的工人，曾参与在美国的苏维埃活动。虽然奥·阿·卡雷克小姐（Miss O.A.Kalyk）并未因积极参与当地共产主义工作而进入我们的视线，但据悉，她曾多次应当地苏维埃特工的要求，用英文打字录入某些秘密文件。
1933年5月26日，V.G.普拉托夫与奥·卡雷克小姐在当地美国总领事馆结婚。目前，他们居住于杜拜尔公寓（Dubail Apartments）204室，地址为杜拜尔路181号，电话号码80731。
最近，普拉托夫夫人离开上海前往青岛度假。

D. B.

特别处主管警官。
